Source: Formula 1, "F1 Schedule 2025" https://www.formula1.com/en/racing/2025 (retrieved 2026-09-24)
The 2025 season calendar lists 24 Grand Prix rounds. Round 18: Singapore Grand Prix, 03-05 Oct 2025.
Rounds: Australia, China, Japan, Bahrain, Saudi Arabia, Miami, Emilia-Romagna, Monaco, Spain, Canada,
Austria, Great Britain, Belgium, Hungary, Netherlands, Italy, Azerbaijan, Singapore, United States,
Mexico, Brazil, Las Vegas, Qatar, Abu Dhabi.
